        #         start = mid + 1
        # return [-1, -1]
        def binSearch(nums, target, leftBias):
            start, end = 0, len(nums) - 1
            i = -1
            while start <= end:
                mid = (start+end)//2
                if nums[mid] == target:
                    i = mid
                    if leftBias:
                        end = mid - 1
                    else:
                        start = mid + 1
                elif nums[mid] > target:
                    end = mid - 1
                else:
                    start = mid + 1
            return i
        
        left = binSearch(nums, target, True)
        right = binSearch(nums, target, False)
        return [left, right]
